{{Removed|date = 29th of October 2020}} {{For|other uses of [[XR (Disambiguation)|XR]]}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = XR901.png |image-dynamic = XR901Dynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Mecha Base]] |type = Vehicle (& Humanoid) |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]45s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]4,500 |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]15 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.1 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]32 |speed = 4 |hidden = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''XR901''' was the fifth vehicle that spawned from the [[Mecha Base]]. It spawned when the [[Mecha Base]] was at Level 5. As with other units, it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. The '''XR901''' had a spawnrate of 45 seconds. '''XR901''' could attack enemies with its turrets. ==Appearance== '''XR901''' was a black tracked mech with neon blue parts to symbolize futurism. It had tracks covered by armor. The operator was protected by a windshield and could shoot bullets using the belt-fed guns. The operator itself had yellow skin, a black torso and white goggles. ==Strategy== *'''XR901''' can easily wipe out hordes of enemies due to its high DPS. **Due to its long range, it can easily attack enemies from a long distance. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''XR901''' will spawn per Level 5 [[Mecha Base]]. It will go down a random path in some maps, like [[Infernal Abyss]], but may always go down one specific path in other maps, like [[Badlands]]. *The '''XR901''' can deal full collision damage to shielded enemies, like the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Templar]]. **Even more interestingly, damage from its turrets is not capped, meaning that the '''XR901''' can operate at maximum DPS against these enemies. *As with other units, the firerate and range of '''XR901''' cannot be boosted by the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]], respectively. *'''XR901''' cannot be stunned by any enemy, making it very useful against such enemies. **It also makes it very useful against major bosses, like the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] or [[Gold Titan]]. *While '''XR901''' can collide with [[Hidden Boss]]es and [[Shadow Boss]]es, it cannot detect them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.6.0GenericThumbnail4.png|'''XR901''' on the game thumbnail. }} ==Trivia== *The goggles worn by the operator inside '''XR901''' are a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|833772989|Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''26 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.6|Release v1.6.0]] **'''XR901''' added. *'''4 March 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.0]] **Health increased from 1,250 to 4,500. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''XR901''' removed, replaced by [[Mark V]]. {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Exclusive Content]]
